dict.string: Grove allows terminal-launched developer tools to use the microphone when you request it.
Grove allows terminal-launched developer tools to use the camera when you request it.
Grove allows terminal-launched developer tools to automate local apps when you request it.
Grove allows terminal-launched developer tools to discover and connect to local development servers when you request it.
Grove opens terminals and file views inside your Documents folder when a project lives there.
Grove opens terminals and file views inside your Downloads folder when a project lives there.
Grove opens terminals and file views inside your Desktop folder when a project lives there.
